new_taxonomy_mappings.reason: Moltbook exposed private communications and email records and permitted a demonstrated unauthenticated post edit. The public connection identifier is not the secret or defect. Distinct read and write operations crossed private-content and owner-edit boundaries; later repair does not erase those operations. Separately, Wiz could no longer revert its live test edit after unauthenticated writes were restricted. This is a concrete test of the post-edit boundary. The Aligned result covers that route and time; it does not certify all tables or recover prior copies.

Moltbook’s database returned agent authentication tokens and private messages containing third-party API secrets. These secret objects left authorised custody. The public Supabase connection identifier is excluded, and possible impersonation is not represented as an observed takeover.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Identifiable information is held or handled by an AI-mediated system or its dependent infrastructure.
condition_tests.assessment: The source episodes identify private messages, emails, agent/API tokens and existing post records within the participating AI-mediated workflow or dependent infrastructure.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An independently evidenced confidentiality or integrity boundary restricts access, acquisition, disclosure or modification of that information for the actor, operation and context.
condition_tests.assessment: The independently evidenced boundary is private audiences, authorised credential holders and owner-restricted post edits.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Occurrence evidence demonstrates that at least one such information operation crosses that boundary. A successful unauthorised retrieval or modification is sufficient; a theoretical route alone is not.
condition_tests.assessment: The realised operation is identified by the source-local decision: Private messages and email records were returned outside their intended private audience. This is demonstrated confidential-content exposure, independently of later use. Wiz changed an existing live post through an unauthenticated write route. Public readability did not authorise an unrelated caller to edit that post. Further private tables remained exposed after the earlier limited repairs. Those later-discovered records were outside the protection achieved on the already restricted routes. The missing backend policies were tested through queries that returned private records and secret tokens, detailed in the following episodes. The connection identifier was intentionally public; the demonstrated private-record retrieval establishes the information boundary crossing.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Identifiable information and its independently evidenced confidentiality or integrity boundary are established for an AI-mediated system or dependent infrastructure.
condition_tests.assessment: This failure-occurrence decision does not assert successful-invariant for the same phase. The identified information and boundary are private messages, emails, agent/API tokens and existing post records, governed by private audiences, authorised credential holders and owner-restricted post edits.

condition_tests.assessment: The evidenced boundary crossing is not verified confinement.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The protective conclusion is restricted to the tested information, actor, operation and route; the evidence supports that result rather than only a configured policy or a claimed repair.
condition_tests.assessment: The evidenced boundary crossing is not verified confinement.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Class scope exclusion (all results): The information is deliberately public for the assessed operation and no independent integrity or other access restriction governs that operation. Public readability does not authorise public modification.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The relevant restriction is private audiences, authorised credential holders and owner-restricted post edits; this is not an unrestricted public read. Publicly readable packages/posts retain separately evidenced write restrictions where assessed.

exclusion_tests.assessment: The access finding concerns private messages, emails, agent/API tokens and existing post records as protected information or a distinct record modification; any secret-only property is separately assigned to the custody class.

exclusion_tests.literal_exclusion: Not aligned exclusion: The observed information operation is validly authorised within the independently established boundary. An approved test does not by itself authorise public release of protected information.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The assessed operation is tested against private audiences, authorised credential holders and owner-restricted post edits. Technical access, research motivation or permission for another target does not authorise crossing this boundary.

exclusion_tests.assessment: The decision relies on the documented operation or named unresolved occurrence fact, not hypothetical severity: Moltbook exposed private communications and email records and permitted a demonstrated unauthenticated post edit. exclusion_tests.assessment: The decision addresses acquisition, exposure or custody-changing modification of authentication material; later action scope is not substituted for this event.
